name: custom_id
label: Custom ID
help_text: Replaces the auto-generated module ID used in HTML and for CSS/JS targeting. Leave blank to use the default.

name: custom_classes
label: Custom Classes
help_text: Additional CSS classes for styling this module.

name: show_on_first
label: Show only on first page
help_text: When enabled, the hero is hidden on paginated listing pages (page 2, 3, etc.). Use when you want the featured post hero to appear only on the main blog index.

name: data
label: Data
inline_help_text: Pulls data from the selected page.

name: tags
label: Show tags
help_text: Display tags below the heading with divider (·), matching SW Blog Post Hero and Post Body. Leave text before tags blank for no label.

name: text_before_tags
label: Text before tags
help_text: Label shown before the tag list (e.g. "Posted in:"). Leave blank for no label.

children.name: heading_size
children.label: Size
children.help_text: HTML heading size

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Size that heading is displayed at

name: author_prefix
label: Text before author line
help_text: Label shown before the author name (e.g. "Posted by:"). Leave blank for no label. Matches SW Blog Post Hero and Post Body.

name: date
label: Include date
help_text: Add " on [date]" to the author line (e.g. " on February 10, 2026").

name: show_author_time
label: Include time
help_text: Add " at [time]" to the author line (e.g. " at 10:23am"). Only available when Include date is on; time is never shown without date.

name: lead_text
label: Lead Text
help_text: Turn on to make the post summary text larger

name: content_style
label: Content style
help_text: Large = larger intro text (balanced or full-width); Small = smaller/secondary; Blockquote = quote/callout. Overrides Lead Text when set.

children.name: module_settings
children.label: Module Settings
children.help_text: Module height, vertical alignment, and spacing. Height cascades from XL unless overridden; vertical alignment defaults to bottom with per-breakpoint overrides.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Spacing
children.help_text: Adjust margins and padding for the module wrapper. Margin creates space between modules; padding creates space around the module content. When no padding is set, use no padding (do not default to 25px).

children.name: max_module_width
children.label: Max Module Width
children.help_text: Default, Small, Large: Use values from Global theme styles > Containers. Full Width: Content spans the full screen. Custom: Enter a specific pixel value (600–2400).

children.name: max_module_width_custom
children.label: Max Module Width (px)
children.help_text: Custom max width in pixels when Custom is selected above.

children.name: module_height_xl_group
children.label: XL Module Height
children.help_text: Height settings for XL screens (≥1200px). Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: module_height_xl_mode
children.label: Minimum Height
children.help_text: Default: no minimum height (content dictates height). Custom Height: set a pixel value. Full Screen: 100vh minus header.

children.name: module_height_xl
children.label: Height (px)
children.help_text: Minimum height in pixels. Cascades to smaller breakpoints unless overridden.

children.name: vertical_align_xl
children.label: Vertical Alignment
children.help_text: Vertical alignment of content within the module at XL breakpoint.

children.name: layout
children.label: Layout
children.help_text: Container class for the hero content.

children.name: container_width
children.label: Container Width
children.help_text: Maximum: 100% of the container. Wide: 83%. Narrow: 66%. Minimum: 50%.

children.name: module_background_settings
children.label: Module Background Settings
children.help_text: Configure the module background: Blog Featured Image, Theme Color, Custom Color, Gradient, Image, or Video. All background styling is in this Style tab. When Video is selected, choose the video source in the Content tab (Module Background Video).

children.name: background_option
children.label: Background Option
children.help_text: Choose the type of background. Blog Featured Image uses the featured post image. When Video is selected, overlay and base color appear here; choose the video source in the Content tab under Module Background Video.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Theme Color
children.help_text: Choose a theme color. For a custom hex color, use Background Option = Custom Color instead.

children.name: background_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Background Option is Custom Color, or fallback for Blog Featured Image / Image / Video.

children.name: background_image
children.label: Background Image
children.help_text: Source for background image or before the video loads.

children.name: background_overlay_color
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Overlay color on top of the image/video.

children.name: background_color_overlay_video
children.label: Background Color Overlay
children.help_text: Color overlay on top of the video. Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: background_base_color_video
children.label: Background Base Color
children.help_text: Solid color behind the video (fallback or before video loads). Shown when Background Option is Video.

children.name: video_autoplay
children.label: Autoplay
children.help_text: Start playing when the page loads (recommended for background video).

children.name: video_loop
children.label: Loop
children.help_text: Restart the video when it ends.

children.name: video_muted
children.label: Muted
children.help_text: Play without sound (required for autoplay in most browsers).

children.name: video_plays_inline
children.label: Plays inline
children.help_text: Play inline on mobile instead of fullscreen.

children.name: content_colors
children.label: Content Colors
children.help_text: Hero content text and link colors. Use when background is image/gradient/custom and theme defaults do not apply correctly. Does not apply to headings—they have their own color settings.

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Theme defaults uses cascade. Choose a theme color or Custom for a hex color when content sits on image/gradient/custom backgrounds.

children.name: text_color_custom
children.label: Custom Text Color
children.help_text: Hex color when Text Color is Custom.

children.name: link_context
children.label: Link Colors
children.help_text: When links are on a dark background, choose Dark. When on light background, choose Light. Required when text color is custom (hex) since cascade cannot infer it.

children.name: hero_image_configuration
children.label: Blog Image Display
children.help_text: How the blog post's featured image is displayed in the hero. Banner Image as Background uses the post image as a full-bleed background with content overlay. Banner Image Above shows the image above the content. Pillar Section Style uses a two-column layout.

children.name: hero_configuration
children.label: Hero Configuration
children.inline_help_text: If the setting looks strange, refresh your page. Sometimes the styles need a refresh to fully apply.

children.name: override_image_border_radius
children.label: Override Image Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the custom Image Border Radius value below. When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings (Design Manager > Theme Settings > Misc).

children.name: image_border_radius
children.label: Image Border Radius
children.help_text: Corner radius for the blog featured image (px). Only applies when Override Image Border Radius is on.

children.name: text_box_width
children.label: Text Box Settings
children.help_text: Width, spacing, alignment, padding, border radius, background, and border for the hero content box. Matches SW Simple Hero standard.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin
children.label: XL Side Spacing
children.help_text: Horizontal spacing from the container edge. Use 0 for no gap.

children.name: text_box_horizontal_margin_sm
children.label: Mobile Side Spacing
children.inline_help_text: Under 768px (SM/XS). Leave 0 to use Tablet value.

children.name: content_area_settings
children.label: Content Area Text Alignment
children.help_text: Text alignment for the hero content area. Can be overridden for tablet and mobile.

children.name: text_box_padding
children.label: Text Box Padding
children.help_text: Margin and padding for the text box content. When empty, uses 32px padding and side spacing from Text Box Side Spacing.

children.name: text_box_border_radius_override
children.label: Override Text Box Border Radius
children.help_text: When enabled, use the custom Text Box Corner Radius value below. When disabled, use the Global Border Radius from theme settings.

children.name: text_box_border_radius
children.label: Text Box Corner Radius
children.help_text: Rounds the corners of the text box. Set to 0 for no border radius. Only applies when Override Text Box Border Radius is enabled.

children.name: text_box_background_color
children.label: Text Box Background Color
children.help_text: Background color applied behind the content box. Default: white at 80% opacity (matches current banner overlay).

children.name: text_box_horizontal_align
children.label: Text Box Horizontal Alignment
children.help_text: Controls the horizontal position of the text box within the hero container.

children.name: text_box_border
children.label: Text Box Border
children.help_text: Border for the text box.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed.

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop.

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.
